name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Fix resumed and encrypted-RAR playback stalling under sustained reads: preserve active read-ahead streams across small forward seeks, reuse cached yEnc segment ranges instead of re-downloading articles during interpolation probes, and retain the previous ciphertext block for sequential CBC decryption. Add regression coverage and diagnostic tooling for seek amplification and time-to-first-frame investigations.
